rationale: The revision makes only the authorized numeric replacement, changing the indirect effect from “b = 0.17” to “b = 0.21.” All other numbers, citations, and substantive wording remain unchanged. Epistemic phrasings hold exactly, including “was associated with,” “predicted,” “are consistent with,” “suggesting partial rather than complete mediation,” “aligns with,” and “may influence.” Neither Basu and Engel (2020) nor Dobrev (2022) was detached or dropped.
